WITH lookup AS (
    SELECT 
        "Ghi tắt",
        "Tên hàng",
        "Loại"
    FROM "sobanhang_ghi_tat"
),
sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s."Ngày",
        s."STT",
        s."Khách",
        s."Hàng",
        s."SL",
        s."Thành tiền",
        s."Ghi chú",
        s."_tra",
        s."_don_tra"
    FROM "sobanhang_so_ban_hang" s
)
SELECT 
    -- order_id
    CAST(strftime(s."Ngày", '%Y%m%d') AS VARCHAR) || '-' || s."STT" AS order_id,
    -- order_date
    CAST(s."Ngày" AS DATE) AS order_date,
    -- order_ts
    s."Ngày" AS order_ts,
    -- product_code
    s."Hàng" AS product_code,
    -- product_group
    l."Loại" AS product_group,
    -- product_name
    COALESCE(l."Tên hàng", s."Hàng") AS product_name,
    -- qty
    s."SL" AS qty,
    -- unit
    NULL::VARCHAR AS unit,
    -- amount
    s."Thành tiền" AS amount,
    -- customer_id
    NULL::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    -- customer_name
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(s."Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'lẻ', 'kl') THEN NULL
        ELSE s."Khách"
    END AS customer_name,
    -- staff
    NULL::VARCHAR AS staff,
    -- channel
    NULL::VARCHAR AS channel,
    -- payment
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payment,
    -- is_cancelled
    FALSE AS is_cancelled,
    -- is_returned
    CASE 
        WHEN s."Ghi chú" LIKE '%trả lại%' OR s."_tra" = TRUE OR s."_don_tra" = TRUE THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_returned,
    -- line_kind
    'item' AS line_kind
FROM sales s
JOIN lookup l ON LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(s."Hàng", '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(l."Ghi tắt", '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
